title: Lovely Algerian Lamb Kebabs
description: A show-off Algerian dish featuring lamb loin chops, ferment-kimchi, and floral notes, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, rose water, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the lamb is cooking, mix the chopped kimchi with chopped parsley.
Once the lamb is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb kebabs with the kimchi-parsley mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
